meta.title: 轻风格质感，灯光质感的三个层次和两个细节
meta.title_en: Lighting Texture: Three Layers and Two Details

scenes.context: 同样的房子，差的只是灯光：一开灯全亮，但没有强弱冷暖重点，质感全被均匀白光盖过去。
sentences: 同样房子差的只是灯光。
Same room, the only difference is light.
均匀白光盖过一切质感。
Even white light washes out all texture.
paraphrase: Same room, the only difference is light.
Even white light washes out all texture.
scenes.speak: Same room, the only difference is light. Even white light washes out all texture.

scenes.context: 同样的空间，照明方式一变，立刻变得高级有质感。
sentences: Change the lighting, and it turns upscale.
Light is the soul of a space.
paraphrase: Change the lighting, and it turns upscale.
Light is the soul of a space.
scenes.speak: Change the lighting, and it turns upscale. Light is the soul of a space.

scenes.context: 基础照明只是空间的底色，能看清地面和家具就行，作用是让你自由走动。
sentences: Base lighting is the room's backdrop.
能看清地面和家具就行。
Just enough to see the floor and furniture.
paraphrase: Base lighting is the room's backdrop.
Just enough to see the floor and furniture.
scenes.speak: Base lighting is the room's backdrop. Just enough to see the floor and furniture.

scenes.context: 沙发旁看书光线不够、厨房切菜被影子挡住，都是缺了功能照明，哪里需要就照哪里。
sentences: 功能照明精准解决需求。
Light exactly where you need it.
paraphrase: Light exactly where you need it.
scenes.speak: Task lighting solves specific needs. Light exactly where you need it.

scenes.context: 氛围照明才是轻风格高级感的核心，墙角落地灯、床头台灯、柜体内嵌灯，点位越低越柔和。
sentences: 氛围光是高级感的核心。
Ambient light is the heart of that high-end feel.
paraphrase: Ambient light is the heart of that high-end feel.
scenes.speak: Ambient light is the heart of that high-end feel. Lower light points feel softer.

scenes.context: 不同色温带来不同情绪状态，像一天中太阳的色温变化，有条件一定要选可调色温的。
scenes.speak: Color temperature sets the mood. Pick fixtures with adjustable temperature.

scenes.context: 太阳光显色性Ra100，高显色光源通常Ra约等于95，能更好还原事物本来的颜色。
sentences: A high CRI brings colors to life.
paraphrase: A high CRI brings colors to life.
scenes.speak: A high CRI brings colors to life. It renders true-to-life colors.

scenes.context: 基础光打亮空间、功能光解决问题、氛围光调出情绪，把钱花在看不见的细节上。
sentences: Base light, task light, and mood light.
Spend on the details you can't see.
paraphrase: Base light, task light, and mood light.
Spend on the details you can't see.
scenes.speak: Base light, task light, and mood light. Spend on the details you can't see.

practice: Base lighting is the room's backdrop.
功能照明精准解决需求。
高显色光源还原真实颜色。
pitfalls: 用基础光做底色、别过亮
均匀白光盖过一切质感
补一盏落地灯做功能照明
功能光精准解决局部需求
低点位柔和光才有层次
不同时段需要不同色温
